name: Carbon-Fiber Landing Legs
summary: Four telescoping deployable legs stowed flush against the lower Stage 1 fuselage during ascent.
function: Deploy pneumatically ~5 seconds before touchdown (~120 m AGL) to absorb residual vertical/lateral landing loads via internal crush-core dampers and stabilize the booster on the deck.
materials: Carbon-fiber composite skin with aluminum honeycomb core and replaceable aluminum honeycomb crush cores inside the telescoping pistons.
history: Block 5 redesigned the landing legs from bolted single-use struts to black-finished retractable legs that can be folded back up on the droneship/pad for rapid turnaround.
